summary: Grupo Aval Acciones y Valores S.A. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a notice of relevant information dated September 14, 2026, disclosing that the Colombian bank holding company paid interest on its Eighth Issuance of Notes, denominated in Colombian pesos and placed in the Colombian market, per the terms of the offering memorandum. No acquisition, divestiture, tender, strategic review, capital return, spin-off, or management change is involved; this is a routine debt-service disclosure mapped to a US current report on Form 8-K. No deal terms, advisor, board recommendation, or regulatory clock apply.
